snippet.title: LOST IN PRAYER - RELEASE DATE TRAILER - 4K
snippet.description:
Lost in Prayer Early Access will start on July 15th on Steam.

You can play the demo now https://store.steampowered.com/app/2849500/Lost_in_Prayer/

More about Lost in Prayer :

Play as your killer : In Lost In Prayer the challenge is to survive, yet the reward lies in dying. When you die, you unlock the creature that kills you for your future runs. In other words, every enemy you face can become a playable character with its own stats and skills.

Hell and Heaven: We know the beginning of Roguelike runs can get really repetitive, really fast, so we're cutting this problem in half by offering two paths: Hell or Heaven.  Each packed with its own dangers and dwellers!

Morality System : We got rid of the traditional RPG skill point system, where you blindly invest in stereotypical attributes like strength for warriors or agility for rogues.. Instead, we’re challenging players to find the right balance between Sins & Virtues, each offering both strength and drawbacks

Extensive skill system : Each character comes with its unique skill tree, and multiple playstyles to explore. Getting out of Purgatory depends on crafting deadly combos and thinking several turns ahead.

RNG, Permadeath, huge replay value, multiple build per characters, secrets and surprises well anything you expect from a Traditional Roguelike
